title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1992-06-14
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi CR-7A, azimuth adjusted > Lynx RCA-XLR cables > Lunatec V3 @ 96 KHz, AES XLR digital out > AES digital input, LynxTwo soundcard in E6400 dual core processor-based PC > HD as 24 bit/96 KHz WAV > Ozone 3.0 > MBIT+ dithering to 16/44.1 KHz WAV > CDWAV 1.9 (tracking) > FLAC (level 8)
source: FOB(30 yrd line) Neumann KM82i's > Sony D5 > Maxell MX90 type IV stereo cassette

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Neumann front‑of‑house capture that lets the nostalgic Shakedown Street moment shine.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the recording’s clarity, noting the unusual but effective use of Neumann shotgun microphones up front. The performance itself is remembered fondly – even a brief mention of “Shakedown” (Shakedown Street) brings back vivid memories for listeners. Together the high‑fidelity capture and the warm nostalgia make this release an enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (5, 5, 4) and uniformly positive comments about both sound quality and the musical experience drive a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with Neumann shotgun microphones positioned up front; reviewers describe the sound as "nice" and "sounds nice", highlighting clarity and an interesting mic approach.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall vibe described as a special, memorable night.
